title: Prohibition
description: An import prohibition: goods of a given origin whose tariff code starts with hs_prefix may not be entered in the jurisdiction for the date range. A prohibition is a state, not a rate; consumers must refuse to compute a landed cost, never return a number. Semantic rule (not expressible in JSON Schema, enforced by tradelattice.spec.validate): when effective_to is a string it must not be before effective_from.

effective_to.description: Exclusive: a measure with effective_to = D is not in force on D. Null means open-ended. A source that states an inclusive end date is normalised by its connector to the day after. When a string, must not be before effective_from (semantic rule).
